rows.headline: A RUNAWAY SHOWDOWN
rows.subhead: {winner} finished far ahead of {loser} over the whole contest, and the Showdown was never really in doubt near the end.

rows.headline: A MASTERCLASS
rows.subhead: From the first season to the last, {winnerClub} delivered a campaign that the rivals could only watch with admiration.

rows.headline: THE BIGGEST GAP IN THE BOOK
rows.subhead: {winnerPoints} against {loserPoints} says it all, and the space between them is a margin of {margin} for {winner}.

rows.headline: ABSOLUTE MONARCHY
rows.subhead: There was no council and no rival court, only {winner} ruling the Showdown from start to finish.

rows.headline: LAPS AND LAPS AHEAD
rows.subhead: By the end {winnerClub} was so far out in front that {loserClub} could barely see the taillights.

rows.headline: AN ERA OF {winner}
rows.subhead: Historians will have little trouble naming the dominant force of this Showdown, and the name is {winner}.

rows.headline: THE SHELVES RUN OUT
rows.subhead: {winner} won so convincingly that the cabinet needs a bigger case to hold the Showdown trophy.

rows.headline: HOMEWORK FOR {loser}
rows.subhead: The runner-up has plenty to study after watching {winnerClub} run away with the Showdown by {margin}.

rows.headline: CHEAT CODE ENERGY
rows.subhead: The Showdown looked rather like a game on easy mode for {winner}, though every point was fairly earned.

rows.headline: OUT OF SIGHT BY THE END
rows.subhead: The leader built the distance patiently and was long gone when the Showdown reached its finish.

rows.headline: A FEAST FOR {winner}
rows.subhead: {winner} laid out a feast of results and took most of it, leaving the Showdown title for the host.

rows.headline: THE LEADING ROLE, ALL ALONG
rows.subhead: Nobody upstaged {winnerClub} for a moment, and the Showdown closes with the star clearly the biggest name on the bill.

rows.headline: THE LANDSLIDE
rows.subhead: The vote of the seasons was overwhelming, and {winner} takes the Showdown with a mandate that no one can question.

rows.headline: IN A LEAGUE OF THEIR OWN
rows.subhead: The whole Showdown was a test of strength, and {winner} was visibly the strongest manager in the room.

rows.headline: SHOWDOWN, SECURED EARLY
rows.subhead: Long before the last page, the writing was on the wall that {winnerClub} was heading for a convincing Showdown win.

rows.headline: COMMANDING FROM THE START
rows.subhead: {winner} kept a tight grip on the Showdown, and {loser} never quite found a way to loosen it.

rows.headline: SUMS THAT DON'T NEED CHECKING
rows.subhead: Nobody asked for a recount, because the finishing totals leave {winner} comfortably and clearly at the top.

rows.headline: A GRAND SLAM OF CONFIDENCE
rows.subhead: {winnerClub} brought belief to every season and left with the Showdown title and a very healthy gap behind.

rows.headline: THE GAP KEPT GROWING
rows.subhead: Each season added to the lead, and by the end {winner} was untouchable at the head of the Showdown.

rows.headline: PACE SETTER SUPREME
rows.subhead: {winner} set the tempo of the whole contest and finished with a gap that the field could only admire.

rows.headline: SILVERWARE IN BULK
rows.subhead: The polish will be needed for weeks, because {winner} won the Showdown by enough to fill several shelves.

rows.headline: A LOPSIDED SAGA
rows.subhead: The story had a clear protagonist from the beginning, and {winnerClub} lived up to the part until the credits.

rows.headline: TOWERING OVER THE TABLE
rows.subhead: Looking up from the standings, {loserClub} can see only {winnerClub}, whose total rises high above the rest.

rows.headline: ROUND AFTER ROUND AFTER ROUND
rows.subhead: {winner} kept winning the argument as the seasons passed, and the Showdown ended with only one side talking.

rows.headline: SUMMIT, ALONE
rows.subhead: {winner} reached the top with air to spare and looked down on a long, empty trail behind.

rows.headline: MAX DIFFICULTY, NO PROBLEM
rows.subhead: The Showdown challenged every manager, and {winnerClub} treated it like a warm up on the way to a clear title.

rows.headline: THE STANDARD IS SET
rows.subhead: {winner} has raised the bar on what a dominant Showdown looks like, and others will chase this record for years.

rows.headline: A MASTER OF THE KITCHEN
rows.subhead: {winnerClub} ran the whole service with calm precision, and the Showdown title is the proof.

rows.headline: THE LONG, UNCHALLENGED REIGN
rows.subhead: With such an enormous lead, {winner} wore the Showdown crown comfortably, and {loser} could only hope for a lucky break.

rows.headline: A STANDING OVATION FROM START
rows.subhead: The crowd was on its feet for {winner} early on, and never really sat down again during the Showdown.

rows.headline: THE BOOKS WILL BE KIND
rows.subhead: The record will describe the Showdown as one of clear superiority, led by {winner} in every sense.

rows.headline: FAR, FAR AHEAD
rows.subhead: {winnerPoints} points to {loserPoints} is a gap you can see from space, and it all belongs to {winner}.

rows.headline: NO CONTEST, ALMOST
rows.subhead: There was a fight early on, but in time {winner} made the Showdown look less like a duel and more like a procession.

rows.headline: ROOM FOR A STATUE TOO
rows.subhead: The cabinet is full and the foyer is next, since {winnerClub} has earned a monument along with the Showdown.

rows.headline: THE FORM BOOK WAS RIGHT
rows.subhead: Those who backed {winner} from the beginning will feel justified, as the Showdown ends with a wide margin.

rows.headline: A CLEAN SWEEP OF GLORY
rows.subhead: The Showdown finished with {winner} so far ahead that the lead feels like a landslide on paper.

rows.headline: SUPREMACY CONFIRMED
rows.subhead: The final totals leave no room for debate, and {winnerClub} is the clear and deserving Showdown champion.

rows.headline: THE ONLY NAME ON THE LIST
rows.subhead: When the page is read to the end, only {winner} stands out as Showdown winner.

rows.headline: UNSTOPPABLE FORCE
rows.subhead: {winner} rolled through the Showdown as an irresistible force, and by the end {loserClub} could only admire the sheer distance between them.

rows.headline: THE WIDE BLUE GAP
rows.subhead: Out on the water, {winnerClub} sailed on while {loserClub} lagged far behind, and the Showdown ended with an ocean between them.
